# CEO Business Balance
> Financial clarity and independence for service-based solopreneurs.

Founded by Stacy Luft, MBA. 30+ years in financial operations.

## Services
- Calm Books Circle: Monthly bookkeeping for solopreneurs ($225/month)
- Momentum Mentorship: Financial mentorship and guidance
- Journey Pathway: Free community membership
